main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 7-bar forward return (forecast > 0)

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: above 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 to confirm; below 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: top third minus bottom third by forecast, mean excess 7-bar return (Welch t)

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and +2 (or its sign disagrees with the mean), which is inconclusive.
reading: Cases are grid bars (positions 0, 7, 14, ... of each window) with forecast > 0 and a 7-bar forward close inside the window; the coin's mean is over all its windows' grid returns; thirds are floor(n/3) cases sorted by forecast (ties by coin and time); the supporting check passes on a difference above 0, with its Welch t reported.
